text: What was the danger?
zh: 危险是什么？
zh_hant: 危險是什麼？

text: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round,
zh: 当那人试图掉转快艇时，
zh_hant: 當那人試圖掉轉快艇時，

text: the steering wheel came away in his hands.
zh: 方向盘在他手中脱落了。
zh_hant: 方向盤在他手中脫落了。

text: He waved desperately to his companion,
zh: 他拼命地向同伴挥手，
zh_hant: 他拼命地向同伴揮手，

text: who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
zh: 那人过去十五分钟一直在滑水。
zh_hant: 那人過去十五分鐘一直在滑水。

text: Both men had hardly had time to realize
zh: 两人几乎没有时间意识到
zh_hant: 兩人幾乎沒有時間意識到

text: what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
zh: 发生了什么，就被猛烈地抛入海中。
zh_hant: 發生了什麼，就被猛烈地拋入海中。

text: The speedboat had struck a buoy,
zh: 快艇撞上了浮标，
zh_hant: 快艇撞上了浮標，

text: but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
zh: 但它继续在水面上快速移动。
zh_hant: 但它繼續在水面上快速移動。

text: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore,
zh: 两人刚开始向岸边游去，
zh_hant: 兩人剛開始向岸邊游去，

text: when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle.
zh: 却沮丧地发现快艇在绕圈行驶。
zh_hant: 卻沮喪地發現快艇在繞圈行駛。

text: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.
zh: 它现在以极快的速度径直向他们冲来。
zh_hant: 它現在以極快的速度徑直向他們衝來。

text: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
zh: 不到一分钟，它轰鸣着从他们身边几英尺处掠过。
zh_hant: 不到一分鐘，它轟鳴著從他們身邊幾英尺處掠過。

text: After it had passed,
zh: 它驶过之后，
zh_hant: 它駛過之後，

text: they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew
zh: 他们尽快继续游泳，因为他们知道
zh_hant: 他們儘快繼續游泳，因為他們知道

text: that the boat would soon return.
zh: 船很快会回来。
zh_hant: 船很快會回來。

text: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger
zh: 他们刚来得及游出危险区域,
zh_hant: 他們剛來得及游出危險區域,

text: when the boat again completed a circle.
zh: 船又完成了一圈。
zh_hant: 船又完成了一圈。

text: On this occasion, however, it had slowed down considerably.
zh: 不过这一次，它明显减速了。
zh_hant: 不過這一次，它明顯減速了。

text: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
zh: 汽油几乎用完了。
zh_hant: 汽油幾乎用完了。

text: Before long, the noise dropped completely
zh: 不久，噪音完全消失了，
zh_hant: 不久，噪音完全消失了，

text: and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
zh: 船开始在水面上轻轻漂流。
zh_hant: 船開始在水面上輕輕漂流。
